stage: Final post-hoc explanatory comparison. The top whole-task simple baseline dtw_support_weighted was selected after seeing endpoint results. Original site diagnostic and endpoint gate remain fixed; no fitting or tuning.
question: On the original teacher-forced static-site diagnostic, does the support-weighted monotone prefix edit-distance method rank correct donor positions more accurately than trained retrieval_17?
data: Use every original query, original-order support and recorded expert prefix from the same development holdout and 764-program external cohort. Verify authentic checkpoint, prior site receipt and per-program rows by hashes. Use identical native AST site tracing, raw terminal and action validation, same-action candidate sets, strata and uniform position-level treatment of exact top ties from diagnostic job 12502139. Validate all within-target coverage counts against the original.
readout: Build the frozen prefix alignment with its original support-only feature weights and compare to the public build('dtw_support_weighted', support) at every teacher-forced boundary including STOP. Check the exact ordered observation/action contents of each donor and each slot, retaining separate occurrences even when complete donor demonstrations are identical. Compute negative D(t,j) minus weighted mismatch between current query sensors and donor sensors at j. Rank these exact stored-position costs restricted only AFTER scoring to donor positions of the gold primitive. This diagnostic ranks slots; the acting policy instead splits one vote per minimizing donor across its distinct minimizing actions. Check that unfiltered position scores reproduce the public policy's unfiltered action votes. Never pass the target's upcoming command or sites to either scorer before computing slot costs.
report: Primary descriptive stratum: gold site available and at least one distinct site produces the same primitive. Report top-1 expected accuracy of dtw_support_weighted and archived trained retrieval_17 with identical denominators, step and distinct-program macro, and trained minus DP paired macro difference. Descriptive 95% percentile interval on that paired difference with 5000 draws resampling whole token-program hashes with replacement, RNG seed 20261120, order-statistic indices 124 and 4874. Also report all steps/site-available and no-move coverage. Do not claim that site agreement causes endpoint success.
